content.what_it_is: MATLAB function Plot_2D (L1-2, signature continued with '...' onto L2) in the FUNWAVE-TVD wave_coherence Spectrum_Generator_for_WKDATA2D toolset: renders the 2D directional wave spectrum as a filled scatter plot of energy over (direction, frequency). In figure(21) (L3) it scatters theta*180/pi (degrees) on x vs freq on y with marker size 75 colored by Spectrum_Energy (L4); x-limits are the radian window [-pi/2+theta_mean*pi/180-0.2, pi/2+theta_mean*pi/180+0.2] scaled by 180/pi to degrees (L5); y-limits [0.03 0.26] Hz (L6); fontsize 12 (L7), grid (L8), colorbar handle h (L9), boxed axes (L10), color axis [0 4] (L11). Section 'line on fp and theta mean' (L12) draws dash-dot reference lines xline(theta_mean) (L13) and yline(fp) (L14). Labels: x '\theta (rad)' (L16), y 'f (Hz)' (L17), colorbar 'E (m^2/Hz/rad)' (L18); xticks -90:22.5:90 (L20). Saves the full view to 'figures/2D_Spectrum_<Coherent_Percentage>p.png' (L22), then under comment '% large view' (L24) narrows ylim to [0.09 0.11] (L25), sets pbaspect [3 1 1] (L26), saves 'figures/2D_Spectrum_detail_<Coherent_Percentage>p.png' (L27), and closes all figures (L28).

unresolved: label/unit inconsistency across lines: x-data is converted to degrees (theta*180/pi, L4) with degree ticks -90:22.5:90 (L20) and xline(theta_mean) plotted directly on that axis (L13, implying theta_mean is in degrees, consistent with the *pi/180 conversions at L5), yet the x-label reads '\theta (rad)' (L16)
comment '% large view' (L24) precedes a ylim narrowing to [0.09 0.11] (L25), i.e. a zoomed detail view — comment wording vs. action mismatch
saveas targets a 'figures/' subdirectory (L22, L27); its existence is assumed and not created in this file
meaning/units of caxis [0 4] (L11) rely on Spectrum_Energy being in m^2/Hz/rad as labeled at L18, which is set by the calling spectrum generator, not this file
